rows.title: Packaged candidate matches its release record and signature verifies
Flag-free clean-profile launch reaches the composer front door
Installed identity and rendered footer agree with the release record
The flag-free journey logs zero zero-base refusal sentences
The tester-channel destination is visible on first launch
A staged clean-profile run leaves Zed and OpenAgents Desktop data untouched

facts.menu_bar_items: Apple, Omega, Edit, View, Thread, Window, Help

rows.owner_instruction: Open every menu in the running candidate and confirm each item either performs its action or is disabled; no item may dispatch a zero-base refusal (the automated log sweep would have caught a refusal fired during the scripted journey, but only a person can exhaustively pull every menu item).
rows.title: Menus advertise only actions the sealed surface admits

rows.owner_instruction: In the staged candidate (launched with a clean --user-data-dir), open the composer executor dropdown, choose Codex, and complete one turn that streams and uses a tool; stop it mid-turn; resume; quit and relaunch; confirm the restored thread still names Codex in title, composer label, and disclosure. Codex auth must use an ISOLATED home (for example CODEX_HOME=$(mktemp -d) codex login --device-auth) — NEVER reuse or copy ~/.codex or any owner credential file into the candidate profile.
rows.title: Direct Codex: send, stream, tool use, stop, resume, relaunch

rows.owner_instruction: Same journey as the Codex row with Claude Code selected. Use an isolated CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR for auth; never reuse or copy the owner's ~/.claude state.
rows.title: Direct Claude Code: send, stream, tool use, stop, resume, relaunch

rows.owner_instruction: Same journey with Grok Build selected: the native ACP server must launch with the shipped command order. Use an isolated Grok config/auth home; never reuse owner credentials.
rows.title: Direct Grok Build: native ACP server, send, stream, stop, resume, relaunch

rows.owner_instruction: Use Add More Agents to open the ACP registry visibly, add one agent that is not Codex/Claude/Grok, authenticate through that agent's own flow if required, run one turn, relaunch, and confirm the restored session names the same agent.
rows.title: Generic ACP: add one registry agent, authenticate, run a turn, restore it

rows.owner_instruction: Run two different direct agents concurrently; switch views between them; cancel one and confirm the other continues; point a second write-capable agent at the occupied worktree and confirm the collision rule fires visibly; relaunch and confirm both threads restore with honest Failed/Cancelled lifecycle states and independent history.
rows.title: Two direct agents concurrently; cancel one; relaunch restores honestly

rows.owner_instruction: From a clean profile, create one conversation in each mode (Direct Agent, Omega Agent, Sarah) twice: once keyboard-only, once pointer-only, all through the composer executor dropdown. Confirm transcript title, composer label, and disclosure agree on the executor each time, and every dropdown row shows one of the four honest readiness states.
rows.title: Keyboard-only and pointer journeys create one conversation per mode

rows.owner_instruction: Send two materially different Omega Agent fixtures; confirm they choose different eligible executors and that decision, reason, override, fallback, and disclosure are visible and durable.
rows.title: Two materially different fixtures route to different executors with disclosure

rows.owner_instruction: As an eligible alpha user: confirm price/hold/limit renders before the microphone opens, start voice, confirm one bounded command, start an agent thread, survive a transient reconnect, end, and confirm the final charge.
rows.title: Sarah admission, voice, bounded command, reconnect, settle

rows.owner_instruction: From the staged candidate send one message to the tester destination; confirm a SECOND account receives it there; kill the relay connection and confirm the outage state renders the documented fallback, not a spinner; exercise moderation/reporting once.
rows.title: Tester channel send/receive with a second account

rows.owner_instruction: Walk every visible Files/Search/Git/Terminal/Review/Settings/agent-registry/Sarah action in the installed candidate; each must work or be visibly disabled with a reason. The hermetic workbench proof (script/omega-workbench-proof) covers the rendered states and is attached as supporting evidence, not as the installed verdict.
rows.title: Every visible work-surface action works or is visibly disabled with a reason

rows.owner_instruction: Drag the DMG's Omega.app beside the existing Zed and OpenAgents Desktop installs, launch it, then upgrade, roll back, and uninstall; confirm only Omega paths change (the automated row already proves a staged run leaves neighbouring app data untouched).
rows.title: Install to /Applications, upgrade, rollback, uninstall touch only Omega paths

rows.owner_instruction: When the public download page exists, confirm page identity, version, platform, artifact digest, signature/notarization state, release notes, and the installed binary agree with this receipt's candidate binding.
rows.title: Download page, version, digest, signature state, notes, binary agree

rows.owner_instruction: Have a reviewer who did not produce the candidate repeat the held-out journey and record the verdict against this receipt's candidate digest.
rows.title: A reviewer other than the producer repeats the held-out journey
